data.narrative:
Volund Manufacturing is a Seed-stage defense & security company that has raised $12M to date, led by founders with deep aerospace and defense backgrounds (Anduril, Blue Origin, Aerojet Rocketdyne). The relevant peer universe comprises 10 comparables across public and private markets: 2 public names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methods triangulate the enterprise value. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x multiplier to the $12M total raised proxy, implying $30M. Peer-median methodology across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Stark Defence at $4.0B, UFORCE at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, NODA AI at $125M) yields a median of $700M, with a range of $125M to $4.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects heterogeneous maturity and capital deployment across the defense tech landscape.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $26M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $365M. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the peer median given material stage and business-model differences within the comp set, and whether the stage-progression multiple adequately reflects this Seed-stage company's relative positioning. The wide range reflects methodological tension: stage-based mechanics suggest lower valuation, while peer benchmarking—dominated by more mature entrants—suggests substantially higher value creation potential.
